name: 伦达尼·穆法马迪
name_full: 伦达尼·穆法马迪 Rendani Mufamadi

last_movies.title: 海贼王(真人版) 第一季

introduction: Actor, Musician and Singer/songwriter originally from Durban now based in Cape Town; Rendani Mufamadi who goes by the musical stage name RENZ. He is an actor with national and international credits to his name, the latest being the international film "Safe House" and Television Cameo on "One Piece" and a supporting role in "1923" which starred Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren. Rendani attained commercial success at the Loeries in 2023 for his performance in the KFC campaign "Anything for the Taste" where he played quality assurance inspector Mr Molapo.Rendani has been playing and writing music from a young age and has co-written and been featured on numerous artists music and is a member of the music collective "Authentic City" Their title song "Champion" from their Debut EP has reached number one on the CCFM Charts and their third single "Headlights" has been playlisted on Carl Wastie’ show on Kfm. His first solo EP title "To My Forever" which features the first single "Dali Wami" an AfroPop/AfroJazz meets amapiano sound and his latest Afropop/Soul Ballad "The Honor" was released in 2023.
